pl-l4d25c5-d1e115.summary: Distinguishes three kinds of simoniacal heresy: some are ordained simoniacally by simoniacs, some simoniacally by non-simoniacs, some non-simoniacally by simoniacs.

pl-l4d25c5-d1e118.summary: Quotes Pope Nicholas: simoniacs ordaining or ordained simoniacally fall from their grade; those ordained simoniacally by non-simoniacs are removed from office; those ordained non-simoniacally by simoniacs are allowed to remain in office by mercy, through the laying on of hands, for the necessity of the time. This concerns those ignorant that their ordainers were simoniacs, who are simoniacs not by guilt but by their ordainer.
claims: Knowing or active simony entails deposition.
Innocent ordinands of simoniacs may remain.

pl-l4d25c5.summary: Distinguishes three kinds of simony: simoniacally by simoniacs, simoniacally by non-simoniacs, and non-simoniacally by simoniacs. Pope Nicholas decreed that the first two fall from their grade or are removed from office, while those ordained non-simoniacally by simoniacs may remain by the laying on of hands, out of mercy and the need of the time; this concerns those ignorant that their ordainers were simoniacs, who are simoniacs not by guilt but by their ordainer.
claims: Those ordained non-simoniacally by unknown simoniacs may remain.
